title: Family friendly e-biking
text:
We had a fantastic time e-biking through Seville. It was such a fun and unique way to explore the city, and the route gave us a great mix of history, scenery, and local culture. Our guide was excellent, very knowledgeable, friendly, and clearly passionate about Seville.

We especially enjoyed riding through the beautiful park, taking in the flowers, fountains, and peaceful atmosphere. We even stopped to feed the pigeons, which was a fun little moment that added to the charm of the day.

The whole trip flew by because we were enjoying ourselves so much. We saw all the major sights along the way
author: Michelle_C

title: Loved seeing all of Seville from the ease of an ebike
text: Having a private or small group tour is the best. Also an E-bike tour is the best way to see and learn about a new city. Do it first thing when u arrive. The local guide can help you understand what you may want to spend more time doing later.
author: Justin_F

title: Fun and Relaxing Stroll Through the Ancient City
text: I am excited to visit Seville, but poor planning resulted in not getting into many iconic sights. I was scrolling through the Viator page, looking for activities to do. This event pops up at my preferred date and time, including my favorite way to explore the city: biking. Claudia and I had a lovely one-on-one biking around the city. She patiently explained to me all the important sights and the history behind them, which tied it back to Expo 29. We bonded over her living in New York City for many years before moving to Seville.
